theme_primary: From Neurobiology to Recovery: Advancing Addiction Medicine
theme_blurb: From Neurobiology to Recovery: Advancing Addiction Medicine — translating the latest neuroscience into evidence-based treatment and lasting recovery.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening clinicians, researchers and recovery leaders advancing addiction medicine and behavioral health.
about_heading: Where addiction medicine meets the next decade.
about_lead: WCAM 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across the full spectrum of addiction medicine and behavioral health.
